item.title: Trump Wants One-Year Cap On Credit Card Interest Rates
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Friday that he wants to impose a temporary federal cap on credit card interest rates.

item.title: KEVIN FRAZIER: Europe’s Digital Protectionism Coming For AI
item.description: When Congress convened a recent hearing on “Anti-American Antitrust,” attention centered on Europe’s Digital Markets Act and its influence abroad, from South Korea to Brazil. The testimony, however, pointed to a wider trend in which foreign governments are increasingly willing to use regulation as a tool against U.S. companies leading in emerging technologies.

item.title: Soros-Backed DA Threatening ICE Agents Dedicated Career To Reducing Charges For Illegals
item.description: A Democratic prosecutor dedicated to helping illegal migrant criminals avoid serious convictions is threatening to throw the book at federal immigration agents.

item.title: Is Trump Blaming The Wrong Culprit For Unaffordable Houses?
item.description: President Donald Trump is going to war against investment firms he says are scooping up homes that families should live in, but there might be another culprit at play.

item.title: Mickey Rourke Surrenders Shotgun Amid GoFundMe Drama
Minneapolis Police Issue Citations To 30 Protesters Seeking To Hound ICE Agents Staying In Hotels
item.description: Minneapolis law enforcement detained 30 protesters outside of two downtown hotels where they believed Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents were staying Friday night, local outlets reported.

item.title: USDA Pauses Grants To Minnesota Amid Somali Fraud Crackdown
item.description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) suspended all active and future grants to the state of Minnesota amid revelations of billions in fraud and a perceived lack of cooperation from state Democrats, Secretary Brooke Rollins announced Friday evening.

item.title: ‘I Love Criminals … I F*cking Hate ICE’: Foreign Pop Star Goes On Unhinged Leftist Rant About US Politics
item.description: Pop star Zara Larsson, a Swedish national, declared her "love" for criminals and a litany of leftist causes — as well as her hatred for U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) — in a rambling Instagram story Saturday.

item.title: NEWT GINGRICH: Venezuela And A Warning To Avoid Quicksand
item.description: While watching President Donald J. Trump’s amazing briefing at Mar-a-Lago on the American capture and extradition of Venezuelan narco-terrorist Nicolás Maduro and his wife, I had two distinct emotions.

item.title: ANDREW MORAN: Mamdani’s Socialist Child Care Plan And The American Baby Bust
item.description: The socialist anthem has been sung, the Quran has been sworn on, and the war on individualism has been declared. Zohran Mamdani is now the mayor of New York City. What a start to the new year.
